meeting_summary.label: Summaries after meetings
meeting_summary.description: The notes from a meeting you missed, or from every meeting if the association has chosen that.

invite.label: Invitations
invite.description: When an association invites you to Simon Says, and reminders about the invitation.

private_summary.label: Summaries of my recordings
private_summary.description: The summary after something you recorded in Personal: decisions, tasks and what has happened since last time.

meeting_brief.label: Before meetings
meeting_brief.description: Ten minutes before a meeting in your calendar: the last meeting, the key decisions and open tasks. For customer meetings in a Company.

meeting_invite.label: Notes from meetings you attended
meeting_invite.description: When someone writes up a meeting you attended and you have no account: your tasks from the meeting and a link in. At most one reminder.
